name: Airport Terminal Bottled Still Spring Water (Room Temperature)
whyItWorks: The #1 non-negotiable health asset for flying with IBD. Drinking 8–12 oz of still, non-carbonated water per hour of flight offsets rapid respiratory fluid loss and prevents blood thickening and stool hardening.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Always buy a large 1-liter bottle after clearing the TSA security checkpoint. Request it unchilled if available.
